opus 1.6.1 — release tarball https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opus-1.6.1.tar.gz
(previously an unversioned git snapshot, which is why CMake reported "Opus project version: 0")

Trimmed on vendoring, no functional effect on Mockingbird:
  - dnn/*_data.c / *_data.h  (22 MB of DRED / OSCE / Deep-PLC weights; Mockingbird builds
    with OPUS_DRED=OFF OPUS_OSCE=OFF so they are never compiled)
  - autotools output (configure, Makefile.in, aclocal.m4, ltmain.sh, config.*,
    compile, depcomp, install-sh, missing, test-driver, INSTALL) — Mockingbird uses
    opus' CMakeLists.txt; package_version is kept because CMake reads it.
Everything else is byte-identical to the release.
